title: Linear Regression
summary: Linear regression fits a line that predicts one variable from another.

key_concepts.explanation: The difference between an observed and a predicted value.
Choosing the line that minimises the sum of squared residuals.

outline.heading: Fitting a line
points: The slope shows the change in the outcome per unit of the input.
The intercept is the prediction when the input is zero.

outline.heading: Checking the fit
points: Plot the residuals to look for patterns.
R squared measures the share of variance explained.

assignments.task: Fit a regression to the housing data set

references: the regression chapter in the lab manual
